entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The instant petition has been filed praying for a writ of mandamus commanding respondents No.3 & 4 not to take the land of the petitioners for purpose of road widening unless it is acquired through land acquisition process and pay proper compensation as per provisions of Act No.
30/2013.
2. Case of the petitioners is that they have their pakka houses in Begumpura near Mundera Chungi.

The details of their title over the land/constructions has been given in paragraphs No. 4 to 10 of the Chandrakali And 5 Others vs State Of Up And 3 Others on 7 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/152738933/
1 writ petition.

entities.text: Chandrakali And 5 Others vs State Of Up And 3 Others on 7 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Case of the petitioners is that Prayagraj Devlopment Authority, Prayagraj is widening the road in front of their houses/shops upto 60 feet and in the process, they are intending to take over possession of the lands of the petitioners without any acquisition and payment of compensation.

3. Shri Arun Kumar, learned counsel appearing on behalf of Prayagraj Devlopment Authority,
Prayagraj states that Prayagraj Devlopment Authority, Prayagraj is not taking possession of any private land.
However, it has passed an order under Section 27 of the Uttar Pradesh Urban Planning and Development Act, 1973 against the petitioners.

entities.text: Uttar Pradesh Urban Planning and Development Act, 1973
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The petitioners after passing of the order on 02.07.2024 have filed objections and the Authority would decide the same and would not take any coercive measure against the petitioners without deciding the objections.

4. Having regard to the aforesaid stand of the Devlopment Authority, we dispose of the instant petition by providing that the objections as have been filed or may be filed by the petitioners within two weeks from today be decided by the Devlopment Authority by a speaking order after giving opportunity of hearing to the petitioners.
5. Until the objections are decided, no coercive measure shall be taken against the petitioners for demolition of their constructions.
The entire exercise in this regard shall be completed within four weeks from today.
In case, the petitioners fail to file objections, if not already filed, within two weeks from today, it shall be open to the respondents to proceed further in the matter in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 7.11.2024 Mukesh Kr.
(Anish Kumar Gupta,J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.)
